findings.problem: House rule break (caption runs ahead of its picture). The caption 'Ant System: all. Elitist rank: best 3. Max-Min: best 1.' is on screen from 3.4 s, but only the first row has its name tag and green blocks then. The 'Elitist rank · best 3' tag and its three green blocks arrive at about 4.6 s, and the 'Max-Min · best 1' tag and its single green block at about 5.3 s. For roughly 1 to 2 s the viewer reads two rules that are not yet drawn. The caption also wraps to two lines and sits lower than every other caption.
findings.fix: Give each rule its own short caption timed to its row, or retime the row reveals so Elitist and Max-Min land within about 0.3 s of 3.4 s and the one caption stays true. For example [3.4,4.6,'Ant System: every ant adds trail.'], [4.7,5.6,'Elitist rank: the best 3.'], [5.7,6.8,'Max-Min: only the best 1.'], keeping 'Fewer depositors...' at 7.0. Each caption then fits on one line.
findings.evidence: node tools/video-still.js lecture-8 s9@3.7,s9@4.3,s9@4.9,s9@5.5: at 3.7 and 4.3 only the 'Ant System · all' tag exists (rows 2 and 3 are unlabelled grey chips); the Elitist tag is up at 4.9; the Max-Min tag at 5.5 (DOM audit also shows the Max-Min tag popping at s9 5.25 s). Caption window is caps [3.4, 6.6]. Stills in scratchpad/l8brand/fine/ and s9-sheet.png.

findings.problem: Off-palette colour during the step-3 cross-fade. The orange tour paths are faded out by opacity while the blue trail lines sit underneath, so for about 0.5 s (6.8 to 7.4 s) every road shows an alpha mix of orange and blue: khaki or olive at 6.9 s and grey-teal at 7.1 s. Neither colour is in the CSLingo scheme, and they appear at the moment the caption says 'update the trails'.
findings.fix: Never alpha-blend two role colours. Fade the orange paths out over a much shorter time (0.15 s), or shrink them away (animate stroke-width to 0 or a dash-offset undraw) so only pure orange or pure blue is ever on screen. Hiding the blue line under each orange path while it is visible would also work.
findings.evidence: node tools/video-still.js lecture-8 s2@6.7,s2@6.9,s2@7.1,s2@7.3,s2@7.5: 6.7 is pure orange, 6.9 khaki, 7.1 grey-teal, 7.5 pure blue. Contact sheet scratchpad/l8brand/s2-fade.png.

findings.problem: The Greek letters alpha, beta and rho are not in the vendored Nunito subsets (unicode-range in css/styles/tokens-main.css has no U+0370-03FF), so they are drawn by a system fallback font. A CDP font probe shows 'α' and 'β' drawn entirely in DejaVu Sans and 'ρ' mixed Nunito plus DejaVu Sans. The recorded mp4 therefore depends on the fonts of the machine that renders it (Arial or Helvetica on a Mac, DejaVu here), which breaks the single sticker typeface. Affects the dial labels (shared dial helper in common-5.js, scenes 6) and the tags 'α = β = 1', 'α = 0: trails ignored', 'β = 0: closeness ignored' (scene 6) and 'evaporation: ρ = 0.5' (scene 7).
findings.fix: Draw α, β and ρ as small SVG paths in the label colour (the video already draws its other symbols as SVG), or use the words alpha, beta and rho in the tags (the captions already do). Do not rely on a fallback font.
findings.evidence: Playwright + CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode at s6@4 ('α' -> DejaVu Sans, system), s6@8 ('β' -> DejaVu Sans), s7@4 ('ρ' -> Nunito + DejaVu Sans). Visible in stills s6@3.0, s6@9.0, s7@3.1.

findings.problem: House rule break (12 px stage margin) that holds for the whole scene. Scene 2: the 'round 1 / round 2' tag sits at x 10, y 6, so it is 6 px from the stage top and 10 px from the left (it also overshoots to about 1 px from the edge while it pops at 9.1 s). Scene 4: the column header tags (trail, closeness, score, chance) sit at y 9 to 10 (pixel margin 7 px at 5.6 s). Scene 6: the alpha and beta dial row is 9 px from the stage top (its text boxes start at y 4).
findings.fix: Scene 2: place the tag at x 12, y 12 (the map starts lower, so nothing collides). Scene 4: move the header tags to y 12 or lower (the row grid has room). Scene 6: shift the dial row, its tags and the five rows down by about 4 to 6 px; the stage has 40 px spare at the bottom.
findings.evidence: DOM bounds audit, sampled every 0.25 s: scene 2 'round 1' tag L10 T6 for 30 samples; scene 4 'score'/'trail'/'closeness' T9-10 for 40+ samples; scene 6 α/β labels T4 and dial thumbs T10 for 40 samples. Pixel margin scan: s2 top 2 (transient), s4 top 7 at lt 5.6, s6 top 9 at lt 3.1.

findings.problem: Jargon and data are not defined on screen. The five jobs are just the letters W, L, P, T and B (Wraps, Leaflets, Posters, Tickets, Banner) and nothing says what they are. The job lengths (W 50 minutes, the others 30) are never shown, so 'ends 50' for the first job cannot be checked by the viewer, and 'ends' and 'due' carry no unit. A first-time learner cannot tell why W ends at 50 or why L is 60 late.
findings.fix: Show each job's minutes on its chip or node when it joins the schedule (for example 'W 50 min'), and either name the jobs once in the intro tag or let the letters stand but say 'minutes' in the 'ends' and 'due' header tags. Keep all text at 28 px or more and inside the 12 px margin.
findings.evidence: Stills s10@0.6 (letters only), s10@6.8, s10@10.1 (chips show 'ends 50 / due 30' with no durations or units). Source: scene-10-schedule.js builds the chips from L8.JOB_IDS only.

findings.problem: The last caption 'All towns visited: back home. Tour length 74 km.' is fully faded in by about 9.15 s, but the tour length tile still reads 55 km until its count-up (9.2 to 9.5 s) and only turns solid at 9.9 s. The 74 km claim is on screen about 0.35 s before the number.
findings.fix: Start the caption at 9.4 (end 11.4), or shorten the first half: 'Home again. Tour length 74 km.'
findings.evidence: s3@9.0: caption 'Tour length 74 km' visible (fading in), tile reads 55 km. s3@11.7: tile reads 74 km.

findings.problem: Colour-role overlaps. The Start node is purple, but purple means closeness in scenes 4 and 6. In the last frames the visited nodes are pale red and the late tags are red as well, so one colour means 'visited' and 'late' in the same picture.
findings.fix: Draw Start in neutral grey with an orange ring (orange is the ant's own colour), and once the lateness beat begins either keep visited nodes grey or leave red for 'late' only.
findings.evidence: s10@3.4 (purple Start), s10@10.1 and s10@13.2 (pink nodes beside red late pills).

findings.problem: Row 1 numbers the three loop steps with blue discs, but scene 2 showed the same three steps as orange discs and blue means the trail everywhere else. Row 3 types '2 + 7 = 9' as text glyphs in a tag, while scene 7 draws the same sum with SVG marks.
findings.fix: Make the recap step discs orange (or grey) like scene 2, and build the '2 + 7 = 9' tag from number chips and L8.mark('plus'/'equals') as in scene 7.
findings.evidence: s11@6.8 (blue discs 1 2 3, tag '2 + 7 = 9') against s2@2.8 (orange step disc) and s7@12.2 (SVG plus and equals).

findings.problem: The video's own convention (storyboard and rules) says symbols such as equals and plus are SVG, not glyphs, yet several tags type them: 'u = random number', 'u = 0.31', 'u = 0.08' (scene 5), 'α = β = 1' and the two 'α = 0' / 'β = 0' tags (scene 6), 'evaporation: ρ = 0.5', 'deposit: Q / L, Q = 100', 'L = tour length' (scene 7) and the recap tag. Harmless in Nunito, but inconsistent with the 'late = ends − due' and '100 / 25 = 4' tiles that use drawn marks.
findings.fix: Either accept typed equals signs in small tags and say so in the rules, or split these tags into text plus an L8.mark('equals') chip. Low priority.
findings.evidence: Source grep of videos/l8/scene-05-dice.js:112-113, scene-06-dials.js:100 and 144, scene-07-update.js:139-141.

findings.problem: The scene kicker (THE LOOP, RECAP and so on) renders at 24 px (and 26 px for the title card's 'CSLingo · explainer' tag), below the 28 px minimum. This comes from the shared engine style (.v-kicker in videos/video.css and cards.js), the same in every lecture, so it cannot be fixed inside videos/l8.
findings.fix: Raise .v-kicker to 28 px in videos/video.css when the engine is next touched; no change needed in l8.
findings.evidence: DOM audit at every 0.25 s: DIV.v-kicker 'RECAP' 24.1 px in the scene 11 stage; same class in scenes 2 to 10 (kicker lies outside the stage box).
